list.name: symbol
list.label: Stock Symbol
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM nepse.stock_price_history WHERE issue_date >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY symbol
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM nepse.stock_price_history WHERE issue_date >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY symbol

targets.rawSql: SELECT issue_date AS time, open_price AS open, high_price AS high, low_price AS low, close_price AS close, volume FROM nepse.stock_price_history WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND issue_date >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT issue_date AS time, close_price, AVG(close_price) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as sma_20, AVG(close_price) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as ema_50, AVG(close_price) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) + (2 * STDDEV(close_price) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) as bol_upper, AVG(close_price) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - (2 * STDDEV(close_price) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) as bol_lower FROM nepse.stock_price_history WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND issue_date >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY 1

WITH changes AS (SELECT issue_date, close_price - LAG(close_price) OVER (ORDER BY issue_date) as change FROM nepse.stock_price_history WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND issue_date >= '2025-01-01'), gains AS (SELECT issue_date, CASE WHEN change > 0 THEN change ELSE 0 END as gain, CASE WHEN change < 0 THEN ABS(change) ELSE 0 END as loss FROM changes), avg_gains AS (SELECT issue_date, AVG(gain) OVER (ORDER BY issue_date ROWS 13 PRECEDING) as avg_gain, AVG(loss) OVER (ORDER BY issue_date ROWS 13 PRECEDING) as avg_loss FROM gains) SELECT issue_date as time, 100 - (100 / (1 + (avg_gain / NULLIF(avg_loss, 0)))) as rsi FROM avg_gains ORDER BY 1

WITH ema AS (SELECT issue_date, AVG(close_price) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS 11 PRECEDING) as ema12, AVG(close_price) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS 25 PRECEDING) as ema26 FROM nepse.stock_price_history WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND issue_date >= '2025-01-01'), macd_line AS (SELECT issue_date, ema12 - ema26 as macd FROM ema) SELECT issue_date as time, macd, AVG(macd) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS 8 PRECEDING) as signal FROM macd_line ORDER BY 1

WITH obv_calc AS (SELECT issue_date, volume, close_price, LAG(close_price) OVER (ORDER BY issue_date) as prev_close FROM nepse.stock_price_history WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND issue_date >= '2025-01-01') SELECT issue_date as time, SUM(CASE WHEN close_price > prev_close THEN volume WHEN close_price < prev_close THEN -volume ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY issue_date) as obv FROM obv_calc ORDER BY 1

WITH ranges AS (SELECT issue_date, close_price, MIN(low_price) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS 13 PRECEDING) as low_14, MAX(high_price) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS 13 PRECEDING) as high_14 FROM nepse.stock_price_history WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND issue_date >= '2025-01-01'), k_line AS (SELECT issue_date, 100 * (close_price - low_14) / NULLIF((high_14 - low_14), 0) as pk FROM ranges) SELECT issue_date as time, pk as percent_k, AVG(pk) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS 2 PRECEDING) as percent_d FROM k_line ORDER BY 1

WITH tr AS (SELECT issue_date, GREATEST(high_price - low_price, ABS(high_price - LAG(close_price) OVER (ORDER BY issue_date)), ABS(low_price - LAG(close_price) OVER (ORDER BY issue_date))) as true_range FROM nepse.stock_price_history WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND issue_date >= '2025-01-01') SELECT issue_date as time, AVG(true_range) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS 13 PRECEDING) as atr FROM tr ORDER BY 1
SELECT CAST(ROUND(close_price/10)*10 AS TEXT) as price_bin, SUM(volume) as vol FROM nepse.stock_price_history WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND issue_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT forecast_date as time, actual_close, predicted_close FROM nepse.stock_forecast WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND forecast_date >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.sector, AVG((s.close_price - s.open_price)/NULLIF(s.open_price,0))*100 as performance FROM nepse.stock_price_history s JOIN nepse.company_info c ON s.symbol = c.symbol WHERE s.issue_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
